name: Lisa M. Nyuli
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Saint Charles, Illinois
education: Northern Illinois University College of Law
about: Partner at Lengle & Nyuli, LLC, in St. Charles, Illinois, Lisa M. Nyuli is a dedicated attorney providing legal counsel in matters of family law. She has over 35 years of experience advocating for clients in cases involving alimony and spousal support, custody and visitation, dissolution, divorce, mediation and collaborative law, marital property and same-sex family law. Trained as a parenting coordinator and a collaborative divorce attorney, she emphasizes cost-effective and responsive legal representation.

Before pursuing her law degree, Ms. Nyuli completed her bachelor’s degree in business administration at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. She then enrolled in Northern Illinois University College of Law, where she earned her Juris Doctor in 1989. In the same year, she was admitted to practice law in Illinois and was further admitted to appear before the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Illinois and the U.S. Supreme Court.

Having been an active participant in the legal community, Ms. Nyuli has served as the president of the Illinois Bar Foundation, the Kane County Bar Association and the Kane County Bar Foundation. She also previously chaired the Family Law Committee of the Kane County Bar Association and the Judicial Advisory Polls Committee of the Illinois State Bar Association. Through her continued involvement with these organizations, she has kept herself informed of the advancements in the field.

Throughout her career, Ms. Nyuli has made significant contributions in the field of family law and was awarded the Family Law Achievement Award from the Kane County Bar Association in 2003. She also received the Presidential Commendation Award, the Board of Governors Award and the Matthew Maloney Tradition of Excellence Award from the Illinois State Bar Association. Her Avvo Client's Choice badge and AV Preeminent* peer-review rating through Martindale-Hubbell recognize her exceptional client service and professionalism.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
